data: Real throwaway Gerrit with generated changes and dummy accounts; no simulated responses.

captions.text: Linux Electron with real Gerrit 3.11.2 and generated data. Two of four files are reviewed.
Enable Unreviewed only to hide the reviewed files.
Click the reset glyph to mark all files unreviewed, including hidden files.
All four files stay unreviewed. Close and reopen to check the saved state.
The reopened review still has zero reviewed files. Older patch sets and the other user are unchanged.
